Variants.Content: The pirate flag was used both to identify the fleet and to instill fear. The flag might represent a captain, an island, or a short-lived alliance, and pirates would also fly false flags to approach their prey; the real determining factor was usually the crew, the distribution of the loot, and which ports were willing to sell the stolen goods.
